description: This file defines a React component 'MindmapCanvas' that renders an interactive, data-driven mind map using SVG. It includes layout logic for positioning nodes and edges, user interaction for zooming and panning, and various specialized node types and connections for a career pathway visualization.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Restricts a number within a specified min and max range.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to string, trims whitespace, returns empty string if null/undefined.

methods.name: numberOrNull
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a finite number or null if invalid.

methods.name: extractPercentRange
methods.description: Attempts to extract a percentage range label from a node's backend fields or title.

methods.name: isLikelyStepNode
methods.description: Heuristic to determine if a node likely represents a step in the pathway.

methods.name: computeLevels
methods.description: Calculates node levels from edges, centered on a specified node.

methods.name: nodeLane
methods.description: Assigns a layout lane based on node properties and isCenter/isRightPrimary flags.

methods.name: buildAdjacency
methods.description: Builds maps of node out-edges and in-edges for easy traversal.

methods.name: chooseRightPrimary
methods.description: Selects the node to be the primary right-side target based on levels.

methods.name: computeLayout
methods.description: Calculates fixed positions for nodes based on design heuristics for the mind map layout.

methods.name: wrapLabel
methods.description: Wraps a label string into multiple lines fitting within max character and line constraints.

methods.name: MindmapCanvas
methods.description: Main React component rendering the entire interactive mind map diagram with zoom/pan, node rendering, and edges.

methods.name: onWheel
methods.description: Handles zooming in/out with the mouse wheel, centered on cursor position.

methods.name: onPointerDown
methods.description: Initializes panning when mouse button is pressed.
